svg.title: Commissioning the jacketed vessel
svg.desc: In the matched tests, the single loop fails the jacket loss with the vessel at 31.74 degrees Celsius while the cascade holds 34.91 degrees; on the setpoint step both meet the requirements and both heaters end at 17 percent. In the lifecycle case the cascade, with Lesson 63's Control Studio gains, transfers from Manual to Auto without a jump, from 15.000 to 16.118 percent, and removes heat in the same update as the sensor fault, staying latched after the reading returns.
svg.text: Control Studio recording of this project · matched setpoint and jacket-loss tests, and the cascade's lifecycle case · numbers answer the predictions
